name: Switch Careers
description: Guides the user through a complete career transition from current field to a new one, spanning 3-12 months with 6 steps covering roadmap creation, skill gap analysis, industry research, portfolio building, networking, and job search. Explicitly branches at Step 1 on currently-employed vs. unemployed status, which affects timeline, risk tolerance, and resource allocation at every subsequent step. Use when the user wants to change careers to a different field or industry. Do NOT use for job searching within the same field (use land-new-job workflow), negotiating at current employer (use negotiate-raise workflow), or starting a freelance practice (use start-freelancing workflow).
